conclusion: Evidence primarily supports room-transfer failure from limited room-level input support and tree reliance on coarse room proxies. CSV internal errors were not found; original sensor-grid/export correctness remains unverified.
confirmed_findings: BM223 is the only model-axis +X room in TRAIN; the held-out fold has a constant X orientation feature and predictions are invariant to changing that coordinate.
Predictions for both focus tasks correlate above 0.99 with BM432's aligned target series.
Small artificial area changes cross large prediction discontinuities in the frozen model; these are sensitivity probes, not recommended BIM edits.
Known-room temporal models have much smaller errors, showing the modeling pipeline can learn room-specific responses when those responses are represented in training.

model_decision.mean_illuminance: Continue investigating log1p or robust loss after input/export review; log1p reduced seven-room mean MAE by 12.4% but does not yet solve BM522 and worsens some rooms.
model_decision.P10: Do not select ExtraTrees globally merely from mean MAE improvement; it substantially worsens several dark-room errors. Prioritize representation and sample support.
model_decision.floor_WFR: Adding existing floor and WFR did not materially resolve either focus task.
model_decision.obstruction: Retain obstruction as a candidate; deleting it worsened seven-room mean-illuminance MAE by about 26%.

next_priorities: Verify BM223/BM432/BM522 original room-to-grid mapping and recompute all five outputs for aligned room-angle-time samples from pointwise lux arrays.

Record comparable physical room depth/width/height, window geometry/location, visible transmittance, workplane/grid conventions and reflectance inputs. Confirm geographic north before engineering relative sun/facade incidence features.
If more simulations are feasible, add training examples covering model +X and small low-obstruction +Y rooms; do not move protected TEST rooms into training.

Re-evaluate improvements across all seven TRAIN room folds, reporting room-level losses and tradeoffs. Diagnostics were informed by development failures, so final claims still require the untouched TEST set later.
calibration_alternative: Room-specific calibration is a separate possible task. The present diagnostic used eight full months of target-room labels, so it does not establish that a few calibration samples suffice.
